experiments.title: Which model to study, and how fast this Mac runs it
experiments.headline: Llama 3.1 8B runs at 269 tokens per second at batch 64 on the M5 Pro; one HarmBench condition takes about 2 to 3 minutes.

experiments.title: Baseline refusal on HarmBench
experiments.headline: The unmodified model refuses 84.3% of HarmBench requests; the judge rates 14.5% of answers as harmful.

experiments.title: Finding the refusal (guardrail) direction
experiments.headline: The guardrail direction sits at layer 11 on template token -5; ablating it pushes the refusal score from 6.5 to -11.8 on held-out harmful prompts.

experiments.title: Suppressing the guardrail direction
experiments.headline: Removing one direction drops refusal from 84.3% to 0.0%; the judge rates 84.9% of answers harmful (baseline 14.5%).

experiments.title: Extracting the 20 emotion vectors
experiments.headline: All 19 emotions are recognised in held-out stories (19-way accuracy 100.0% at layer 9, chance 5.3%); on the independent short-text set, 80.7%.

experiments.title: Do the emotion vectors steer emotion
experiments.headline: At layer 12 and strength 1.0, an unsteered reader names the injected emotion 32.9% of the time (chance 5%).

experiments.title: How emotion vectors line up with the guardrail direction
experiments.headline: At layer 11, hostile points most towards the guardrail direction (cos +0.08) and happy most away (-0.09); random directions stay within plus or minus 0.039.

experiments.title: Emotion injection against HarmBench
experiments.headline: Strongest emotion condition specific:happy@12:0.5: ASR 52.2% against 14.5% with no injection.

experiments.title: Random vectors of the same size
experiments.headline: Random pushes, strength 0.5: mean 22.1% (sd 7.9, 12 seeds, range 9.4% to 32.7%); strength 1: mean 43.4% (sd 19.4, 4 seeds, range 29.6% to 71.1%). Baseline 14.5%.

experiments.title: Text-level emotional priming (FreakOut style)
experiments.headline: Stress, relaxation and neutral system prompts

experiments.title: Emotion vectors with the guardrail part removed
experiments.headline: Removing the refusal component does not weaken the effect: mean ASR 20.6% with it, 23.1% without (19 emotions, baseline 14.5%).

experiments.title: Does geometry predict the attack
experiments.headline: Spearman rho between cosine and ASR change = -0.18 (permutation p = 0.473, 19 emotions, layer 12, strength 0.5).
